info.title: com.clodhub/gift-cards
info.description: Gift cards bought online or given by the shop: amount cards that keep a balance, item cards worth one service, and packs of sessions bought under a promotion. A purchase is kept from its payment (the provider's checkout or an app's payment sheet, through com.clodhub/payments) until fulfilment issues its card; codes come from com.clodhub/voucher-codes and cards and purchases are kept in com.clodhub/records. The rules (value against a basket, usability, views, purchase checks, booking links) run in the browser and on the server; the service is server only. Amounts are integers in minor units.

methods.name: matchesItem
methods.description: Whether an item card or pack is for this basket line: by slug when the card has one, else by name ignoring case and surrounding space. Amount cards match nothing.

methods.name: cardValue
methods.description: What the card takes off a basket: an amount card what is left on it (balance); an item card or pack the full price of the first matching line, whatever was paid for the card; 0 when no line matches.

schema.description: An amount in the currency's minor unit (cents for EUR).

methods.name: usability
methods.description: Whether the card can pay for a booking at `now`: not_found without a card, expired after expiresAt, redeemed when every session is used; otherwise the sessions left.

schema.description: A JavaScript Date; shown here as its ISO 8601 text.

methods.name: publicView
methods.description: The card as anyone holding its code may see it.

methods.name: adminView
methods.description: The card as staff see it, with the status at `now` (an issued card past expiresAt is expired).

schema.description: A JavaScript Date; shown here as its ISO 8601 text.

methods.name: validatePurchase
methods.description: Checks and tidies a purchase: the four names and addresses present (MISSING_FIELDS) and addresses well formed (INVALID_EMAIL), kept in lower case; an item card names its item (MISSING_ITEM); the amount a whole number from minimumAmount to maximumAmount (INVALID_AMOUNT); text within its limit (TOO_LONG). With a pack offer the card is an item card for pack.packSize sessions at pack.price, which the amount bounds do not limit, and needs the item's slug. A missing or unknown language becomes en.

methods.name: bookingPath
methods.description: Where the card's emails send the recipient to book: <prefix>/reserve?item=<slug>&minutes=<m>&locked=true&gift=<code> for a card with an item slug (minutes only when known), else <prefix>/reserve?gift=<code>.

schema.description: A language prefix such as /en, or an origin with it; empty by default.

methods.name: settingsFrom
methods.description: Converts and checks settings; unset and unrendered values take the defaults (DEFAULT_SETTINGS).

methods.name: installedSettings
methods.description: The settings clod rendered at install, converted by settingsFrom.

methods.name: createGiftCards
methods.description: The gift card service over the store's giftCards collection (GIFT_CARDS_COLLECTION).

methods.name: GiftCards.ensureIndexes
methods.description: Creates the indexes: of the cards code and checkoutId unique, status, expiresAt, senderEmail and recipientEmail; of the purchases senderEmail and createdAt (newest first).

methods.name: GiftCards.checkout
methods.description: Checks the purchase (as validatePurchase, with options.pack), keeps it pending under a new id and token, and starts its payment: one line item at the purchase amount, the sender as the customer and metadata kind gift with purchaseId. A checkout payment (createCheckout, in the purchase's language) ends 24 hours later; a sheet payment (createSheetPayment in the SDK's API version) does not end. When the payment cannot start, the purchase is deleted and CHECKOUT_FAILED carries the payments failure code as reason.

methods.name: GiftCards.fulfil
methods.description: Issues the card a completed gift payment (a checkout or a sheet payment) paid for, from the purchase its metadata purchaseId names, and marks the purchase paid, once: a second call for the same payment id (a repeated webhook, or two at once) returns the first card with created false. NOT_GIFT when metadata.kind is not gift, NOT_PAID when unpaid, INVALID_METADATA when purchaseId names no purchase, PAYMENT_MISMATCH when the payment's amount or currency is not the purchase's. A payment arriving after a checkout's expiresAt still issues the card. The amount bounds are not applied again. The card expires validityDays after issue.

methods.name: GiftCards.purchase
methods.description: The purchase with this id whose token this is, as it stands now, with the cards its payment issued; null for any other id or token (text of 1 to 200 characters).

methods.name: GiftCards.purchasesByEmail
methods.description: The purchases an address made (its senderEmail), newest first (by createdAt, then _id), each with its cards; text that is not an address gives []. For a customer's wallet: the application confirms the address (com.clodhub/email-verification) first.

methods.name: GiftCards.cardsByEmail
methods.description: The cards an address bought or received (its senderEmail or recipientEmail), newest first (by issuedAt, then _id), in every state; text that is not an address gives []. For a customer's wallet, as purchasesByEmail.

methods.name: GiftCards.issueFree
methods.description: Issues a card the shop gives away (issuedBy admin, checkoutId admin-<code>) after the checks of validatePurchase.

methods.name: GiftCards.lookup
methods.description: The card with the code a person typed (normalised by com.clodhub/voucher-codes), or null.

methods.name: GiftCards.validate
methods.description: The public check of a code before booking: valid with the public view, or the reason it cannot be used.

methods.name: GiftCards.usable
methods.description: The card and its sessions left when it can pay for a booking now, else the reason (as usability).

methods.name: GiftCards.redeem
methods.description: Staff use the card when the customer comes in: one session of an item card or pack; of an amount card the options' amount, or without one all that is left. The use that leaves no session or no balance marks the card redeemed. Refusals: 400 INVALID_AMOUNT (an amount that is not a whole number from 1 to 2147483647, or an amount for an item card or pack), 404 NOT_FOUND, 410 EXPIRED (with expiresAt), 409 REDEEMED (with redeemedAt) and 409 INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE (an amount above the balance, given). Staff redeeming at once each take from what the other left, never more than the card has.
